# Staffify

> Staffify is a workforce infrastructure company (Miami, FL, founded 2023) that places dedicated, full-time virtual assistants, executive admins, customer service reps, video editors, and sales staff inside US service businesses. Talent is screened from roughly 200 applicants per role down to 3 client-interviewed finalists, trained on the client's tools before day one, monitored and managed after placement, and backed by a lifetime replacement guarantee.

## Key facts

- Hourly pricing: $11.25 to $14 per hour all-in ($12.50/hr is typical). Includes payroll, HR, real-time monitoring, training, and replacement. A full-time VA runs about $2,167 per month.
- One-time onboarding: $2,499 standard, $2,099 with a 24-hour decision. A no-interest financing path rolls it into the hourly rate.
- Timeline: 14 to 20 days from kickoff to the VA's first billable hour. Sourcing takes about a week.
- Screening: written screens, live video interviews, paid skills tests, and called references. Roughly 200 applicants become 3 finalists.
- 95% client retention. 8% annual VA attrition. Month to month, no long-term contracts.
- VAs are paid above their local market with PTO, benefits, and career pathing. Every placement is dedicated to one client, never shared or pooled.
- Contact: hello@gostaffify.com
